Sa operasyon ng MMDA Swift Traffic Action Group (STAG) laban sa mga iligal na nakaparadang sasakyan, ilegal na terminal, at iba pang paglabag sa trapiko, nasa 168 ang nahuli sa ilalim ng No Contact Apprehension o ang panghuhuli sa pamamagitan ng body-worn cameras habang 21 naman ang physical apprehension.

Sakop ng operasyon noong Oktubre 28 ang Boni Serrano, Santolan, Benitez, Mariposa, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th Ave., Harvard, Oxford, Imperial, at 20th Ave sa Quezon City.

Layunin ng operasyon na mapanatili ang kaayusan sa daloy ng trapiko at masiguro ang kaligtasan ng mga motorista at pedestrian sa mga nasabing lugar.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE 

29 OCTOBER 2025

FATAL ACCIDENT ALONG COMARO ROAD, BASSONIA

A fatal accident has been reported along Comoro Road, between Tarentaal Avenue and Pieter Acryod Avenue, south of Johannesburg, involving two vehicles, a Toyota Quantum minibus taxi and a bakkie.

Multiple injuries have been reported with seven fatalities confirmed from the minibus taxi.

Emergency personnel and law enforcement officials are on scene, and Comaro Road is blocked off to traffic in both directions.

Motorists are advised to avoid Comaro Road and to use alternative routes, as vehicles are being diverted at Pieter Acryod Avenue and Soetdoring Avenue.

ENDS

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department Communication Unit #SaferJoburg #NomakanjaniManjeNamhlanje #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic
